findings.title: Cutoff bound is displayed as an exact internal minimax value
findings.evidence: For the actual27LEAVES, the third root-child MIN has exact value min(max(6,5,3),max(8,1,9),max(4,2,5))=5. With inheritedalpha6, it cuts after its firstMAXchild6 and returns fail-soft6. The renderer writes bare6 at that node. The root exactvalue remains6. This is an analytic trace review, not executed playback.
findings.proposed_fix: Record bound type atcutoffs and label MINupperbounds≤v/MAXlowerbounds≥v (or hide incomplete values); retain exactroot. Add actualtoy regression.

findings.title: Busy-beaver definition omits fixed binary alphabet
findings.evidence: The displayed definition quantifies all n-state machines, but quoted BB(5)=47,176,870 applies to the standard2-symbol model. No spoken/on-screen2-symbol qualification occurs in the block; implementation is binary. Officialbbchallenge explicitly fixes5states/2symbols.
findings.proposed_fix: State n nonhalting states and2 tape symbols (plus a separate halt state), blank/all-zero tape, in caption/narration.

findings.title: Two different optimal routes are called the same path

findings.title: Strict interior wording excludes boundary expansions and the counted goal

findings.evidence: Korf ownIJCAI1985introduction states iterativedeepening was repeatedlyrediscovered and credits earliestdocumenteduse toSlate/AtkinChess4.5(1977); his1985paperproposes/analyzesIDA*. CurrentVOcalls generaliterativedeepening fromKorf1985.

The lowTstatementalso concerns stationaryequilibriumfamily, not arbitraryfinitecoolingschedule.
